plan: [In a sealed-bid second-price auction, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy: you win whenever the second-highest bid is below your value and then pay that bid, maximizing expected surplus. With independent uniform values and no prior history to exploit, there is no reason to deviate. Bidding 22 (my true valuation) avoids overpaying while capturing all positive-profit wins. $0.1 increments are allowed, so 22 is valid.]

Ties are resolved randomly, but bidding truthfully protects long-run profit given independent draws and one-shot play.]
